title: carduus lactifolius
intro: Carduus lactifolius, commonly known as White Cockle, is a biennial herbaceous plant belonging to the sunflower family (Asteraceae). It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and supporting liver function, due to its diuretic and hepatoprotective properties. The therapeutic actions of Carduus lactifolius are attributed to its ability to stimulate the lymphatic system, promote blood circulation, and exhibit antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
